description: Trivy findings suppressed for one exact (target, package, installed version, vulnerability) tuple. .trivyignore can only match a CVE id repo-wide, so anything that must stay visible elsewhere goes here instead. Applied to Trivy JSON output by apply-scoped-ignores.sh in security-scan.yml and sast-auto-remediate.yml.

ignores.reason: Planted CVE under test for the dependency-cve-remediation exercise. commons-text 1.9 is pinned on purpose; remediations land on demo branches, never here. See security/deps/advisory.yaml and .agents/skills/dependency-cve-remediation/SKILL.md.
